_comment: A1 receipt — demo2.steg.eth provisioned end-to-end via the onboarding wizard (POST /provision, option B). Re-provision of a SECOND fresh name to prove the wizard runs HANDS-OFF with no manual recovery (the real test of the Bun-crash fix from milestone 7). One operator Ledger sig (the mint); everything else hot-key/TEE-signed. All on mainnet 2026-06-19.
name: demo2.steg.eth
provisionedVia: POST /provision (brain) — wizard, hands-off; mint pre-step was operator Ledger

tx._note: mint = operator Ledger (setSubnodeRecord, owner=hot key). bind txHash surfaced by /provision (AgentBound decode). The fund, forward-records (setAddr+auth.credential+trust-models), ENSIP-26 records, agentURI, ENSIP-25, reverse (TEE), and transfer-to-operator txs were broadcast by /provision (hot key / TEE) and not surfaced in the SSE stream — all verified from current on-chain state below.

budget.hotKeyNetSpend: ~0.000538 ETH (~0.0003 of which parked in the server wallet, recoverable; ~0.000238 actual gas burn)
budget.note: Lean budget validated — 0.008 ETH (the prior preflight floor) would have been ~15x overkill.

codeChanges: brain/app/provision_routes.py: REVERSE_GAS_ETH 0.001 -> 0.0003 (reverse setName is ~114k gas, ~0.000024 ETH at sub-gwei).
scripts/fund-wallet.ts: gas buffer 0.001 -> 0.0002 for a 21k transfer.
status: COMPLETE — second discoverable, verifiable, operator-gated agent live on mainnet
note: A1 PASSED: the wizard ran all 9 steps HANDS-OFF with NO Bun crash and NO manual recovery — validating the milestone-7 fix (buildEnsBatch now encodes the resolver multicall in-process with viem, no nested ens-cli subprocess). The only intervention was right-sizing two over-conservative gas constants before the run (above); both are improvements, not recoveries.
